title: Two percent of a household bill
hook: Two stated cases: explore the baseline behind a relative energy change.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the baseline behind a relative energy change affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Final, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the baseline behind a relative energy change in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
